# Abhishek Bhattarai

> Portfolio of Abhishek Bhattarai, a senior software engineer, plus the small apps he builds and ships.

## Apps

- [Pin To Top](https://bhattaraiabhishek.com.np/apps/pintotop): Free, open-source Mac app that keeps a video call (FaceTime, Zoom, Google Meet, Teams) or any other window floating on top, even over full-screen apps and across every Space. macOS 14+, Apple Silicon. MIT license. Source: https://github.com/Abhishek-programs/PinToTop
- [FullOpen](https://bhattaraiabhishek.com.np/apps/fullopen): Free, open-source Mac app that opens any app straight into full screen. Right-click the app in the Dock, Finder or search, or hold Shift while it opens. macOS 14+, Apple Silicon, builds from source with one line. MIT license. Source: https://github.com/Abhishek-programs/FullOpen
- [Bicha ma Bhetam](https://bhattaraiabhishek.com.np/apps/bicha-ma-bhetam): Free web app for friend groups in Kathmandu. Finds the middle of the group, suggests cafes and landmarks around it, shows everyone's rough ride, and keeps score of who has ridden the most. No login.
- [All apps](https://bhattaraiabhishek.com.np/apps)

## Pin To Top: short answers

- Problem it solves: on a Mac, going full screen in another app hides your video call, so you keep swiping back to see faces. macOS has no built-in "always on top" for other apps' windows.
- How it works: it captures just the pinned window with ScreenCaptureKit and shows it in its own floating panel that joins every Space and full-screen app. The original window never moves.
- Privacy: video only, audio capture off, frames stay in memory, no network code.
- Options: show on one display or all displays; launch at login.
- Limits: view-only mirror (click the original window to mute or leave); Apple Silicon only; not notarized yet, so the DMG needs "Open Anyway" once, or use the one-line Terminal install.
- Install: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Abhishek-programs/PinToTop/main/install.sh | zsh
- Download: https://github.com/Abhishek-programs/PinToTop/releases/latest/download/PinToTop.dmg
